title: Thai red curry

choose.title: Tofu (vegetarian)
choose.notes: For a fully vegetarian curry, use soy sauce instead of fish sauce and leave the shrimp paste out of the curry paste.

steps.text: Make the curry paste, unless using a batch you made earlier.
Start the rice so it's ready when the curry is.

steps: Heat the oil in a large wok or saucepan over a medium-high heat.

steps.text: Brown the chicken for 3–4 minutes, then lift out onto a plate.
Fry the tofu until golden on all sides, then lift out onto a plate.

steps: Add the curry paste, with a splash more oil if needed, and fry for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and the oil starts to separate.
Pour in half the coconut milk, stir well and simmer for 3–4 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, the fish sauce and the sugar. Bring to a gentle boil, then add the pepper and bamboo shoots.

steps.text: Return the chicken and simmer for 10–15 minutes until it's cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Return the tofu and simmer for 10–15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the seafood and simmer gently for 5–8 minutes until just cooked.

steps: Stir in the torn lime leaves and Thai basil just before taking off the heat. Serve with the rice.
notes: The curry paste can be made up to a week ahead. Browning the chicken and frying the tofu first are changes from the original method, which added them straight to the coconut milk.
